feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1120 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Boba Tea Shop Profit Calculator — Break-Even and Ramp-Up
entry.summary: Free pro forma for boba, bubble tea and specialty drink shops: profit per cup, break-even cups a day with the loan, the price for your target margin, delivery-app cost, and a 60-month ramp-up with the cash reserve you need. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Convenience Store and Gas Station Profit Calculator — Fuel Margin After Card Fees
entry.summary: Free convenience store and gas station profit calculator: fuel margin after card fees, inside sales mix, labor and rent become monthly profit, break-even gallons, debt coverage and fuel margin sensitivity. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Ice Cream Shop Seasonal Profit Calculator — Break-Even and Off-Season Cash
entry.summary: Free ice cream shop profit calculator: twelve months of days open and customers per day become monthly profit, break-even customers, open-or-close verdicts, loan coverage and the cash reserve the slow months need. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Kombucha Brewery Profit Calculator — Break-Even, Gallons a Week, Payback
entry.summary: Free kombucha brewery profit calculator: fermenter capacity, batch cycle, wholesale and taproom prices, packaging, labour and rent become gallons a week, monthly profit, break-even, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: NIS2 Scope Checker — Am I an Essential or Important Entity?
entry.summary: Free NIS2 scope checker: pick your sector and enter staff, turnover and balance sheet to see whether Directive (EU) 2022/2555 likely applies to you, as an essential or important entity, with the main duties. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: npm Audit Triage — Which npm audit Vulnerabilities Does Your Code Actually Use?
entry.summary: Paste npm audit --json and your source imports: see which vulnerable packages your code actually imports, which are only reached through a dependency, and which are test-only noise. Free npm audit triage, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Pet Boarding and Daycare Profit Calculator — Occupancy, Staffing, Break-Even
entry.summary: Free dog boarding and daycare profit calculator: runs, daycare spots, prices, occupancy and attendant ratio become monthly profit, staffing steps, break-even occupancy, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: pip-audit Triage — Which Python Vulnerabilities Does Your Code Actually Import?
entry.summary: Paste pip-audit -f json and your Python source: see which vulnerable packages your code actually imports and which are test-only or unreferenced noise. Free pip-audit triage, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: 3PL Invoice Audit Checker — Did Your 3PL Overbill You?
entry.summary: Check a 3PL invoice against your contract rate card and your own records. Flags rates above contract, duplicate lines, charges not in the rate card, minimum double billing and storage over average on-hand, totals the recoverable dollars and writes the dispute email. Free, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Arcade Game Payback Calculator — Which Games to Keep, Move or Cut
entry.summary: Free arcade game payback calculator: plays, credits, ticket payout, floor space and upkeep become weekly profit, payback, break-even plays and a keep, watch or cut verdict for every game. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.summary: Free calculator for axe throwing bars and venues. Enter thrower capacity, sessions, fill, ticket price, private events, leagues, staff, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even fill and the lowest ticket for your target margin and payback. Private, in your browser.
